messages:
Alex R: heads-up — seeing correlated spikes in GPU package power and node-level packet loss across us-west-2 this morning. plotting in Grafana now, thinking we need a correlation panel.
Marina G: can you add an example query? is this hitting specific instance types or spread across p4/p3/p5?
Alex R: quick checks look across both p4d+p5, but higher on a subset of p4d. rough PromQL I used:
```
avg by(node, gpu_uuid)(rate(nvidia_power_draw_watts_sum[1m])) as gpupower
increase(node_network_tcp_retransmits_total{device!~"lo"}[5m]) as tcp_retransmits

# join is manual in grafana: show gpupower and tcp_retransmits on same time axis (dual y)
```
Priya S: if packet loss is upstream it can cause retries/backpressure and GPU drivers may bump power/clock while recovering. also noticed thermal_throttle_count rising on the same nodes.
Jun L: proposal: make a composite panel — top: time series dual-axis (power W vs tcp retransmits), middle: table of top offending pods by retransmits and pod->node mapping, bottom: AZ heatmap of nodes colored by severity. add an annotation for kube-scheduler events.
deploybot: dashboard update 789 applied to staging (dash-id: gpu-network-correlator).
Marina G: we should also surface pod->node affinity labels to check if scheduler placed pods cross-AZ causing cross-host traffic. include node_labels_az and kube_pod_node_affinity_score if available.
Alex R: agree. also flagging cost impact: repeated power spikes increased burn on affected nodes by ~12% last week for that job; if sustained we should throttle batch workloads by AZ.
Priya S: can someone draft an alert rule? rough idea: (avg by(node)(increase(nvidia_power_draw_watts_sum[5m])) > 300 && increase(node_network_tcp_retransmits_total[5m]) > 50) for 5m — if true, page oncall.
```
# alert expr example
(ALERT GPUHighPowerWithPacketLoss)
expr = (avg by(node)(increase(nvidia_power_draw_watts_sum[5m])) > 300) and (increase(node_network_tcp_retransmits_total[5m]) > 50)
for = 5m
labels = {severity="page", team="infra"}
annotations = {summary="GPU power spike with network retransmits on {{ $labels.node }}"}
```
Jun L: :thumbsup: I’ll mock up the panels in staging and add alert rule to the canary alerts. tagging @Alex R for review once pushed.
Alex R: thanks. on-call runbook note: if alert fires, run `ip -s link` on host and check switch telemetry; if packet loss persists >15m cordon node and start migration of workloads. also add follow-up to test qdisc/tcp_congestion settings for those instance types.
incidentbot: created ticket INF-4232 for follow-up triage and cost impact analysis.
_meta: generated for dataset — slack thread about building a Grafana correlation panel for GPU power vs network packet loss, includes PromQL snippets, alert example, and operational steps
